# Vendored: BrendanJamesLynskey/CORDIC

These files are an unmodified copy of part of
[BrendanJamesLynskey/CORDIC](https://github.com/BrendanJamesLynskey/CORDIC)
at commit **`fe4775e43015068a8aca730f631d16f7d500aeb4`** ("Add MIT licence"),
under that repository's MIT licence (`LICENSE`, copied alongside).

They are the reference RTL the project is anchored to:

* `tests/test_bitexact_rtl.py` simulates the two reference modules and checks
  the golden model `hw_dse.models.cordic_bitexact` is bit-exact against them on
  all 65,536 input angles;
* `tests/test_rtl_generator.py` checks the RTL generated by `hw_dse.rtl` for the
  default configuration (`iterative` and `pipelined`, W=16, N=14) produces
  bit-identical outputs to these modules;
* the two Vivado calibration anchors in
  `src/hw_dse/models/calibration_artix7.yaml` are synthesis results of these
  two files (reports in the source repo's `synthesis_logs/`).

Only the circular-rotation modules and their testbenches are copied; the
source repo's other CORDIC modes and its Vivado logs are not needed here.

Do not edit these files. To update, copy the new versions from the source
repo, update the commit and the hashes below, and run
`python scripts/check_vendored.py` (CI runs it too).
